description: Enqueue persists and hashes the exact canonical sanitized payload rather than a reference or pre-sanitized input.
Changing either payload_schema or output_schema changes input_hash for otherwise identical class input.
An exact retry after the accepted submission closes the lease replays the original receipt.
An exact accepted submission retry wins over the later lease-expiry terminal check.
Contract expiry does not erase the exact-retry receipt for an already accepted holder submission.
Admission halt refuses new work but preserves exact retries for accepted in-flight submissions.
Emergency halt invalidates future use but does not prevent an authenticated holder from replaying its immutable receipt.
Permit withdrawal supersedes work while retaining byte-identical replay of previously accepted receipts.
A retry with a different result hash conflicts and leaves the accepted row unchanged.
Worker binding precedes replay lookup so another worker cannot retrieve an accepted receipt.
A non-holder cannot extend a lease and receives only the coarse refusal.
A non-holder cannot abandon or requeue another worker's lease.
Invalid submission settlement closes and requeues the stamped-cycle lease, releases its current-window contribution occurrence, and records qualifying failure evidence atomically.
A submission losing the durable contract-cutoff race returns contract_expired and settles its lease with coordinator-fault contribution accounting in the same transaction.
The first exact non-unanimous same-cycle evidence set durably marks an absorbing split before bounded split-only rerouting opens.
An identical effect intent retry returns the immutable initial authorization receipt.
An authorized retry replays the same complete ActionAuthorization inside its initial receipt.
Reusing an effect intent ID with a different decision result hash is an authorization conflict.
Reusing an effect intent ID with a different canonical intent hash is an authorization conflict.
An identical result verdict retry replays the persisted canonical verdict receipt without consuming capacity twice.
A second different result verdict conflicts and preserves the canonical accepted verdict.
A new result verdict arriving after another terminal transition is rejected as terminal.
An identical action verdict retry replays the same receipt and authorization.
A different action verdict for the same request conflicts without changing the approved record.
An action verdict cannot move a request that already reached a different terminal state.
Emergency halt cancels affected results, pending adjudications, and issued authorization validity atomically.
Withdrawing a permit epoch supersedes its affected results and invalidates issued authorizations.
Contract expiry expires affected results and invalidates authorizations under that version.
Max in-flight lifetime expiry invalidates prior authorizations and atomically starts a fresh cycle.
Operator cancellation cancels only the selected scope and invalidates its issued authorizations.
A retired verified decision is unavailable to a new effect intent even though its historical record remains.
Permit withdrawal supersedes a result even when one authorization issued and another remains pending.
A rejected result adjudication below the cap starts exactly one fresh collection cycle.
A rejected dispute at the configured cap remains terminal and does not create another cycle.
A result-level dispute requeue increments collectionCycle rather than replacing a lease in the same cycle.
Starting a new collection cycle does not erase lease-keyed receipts from an older cycle.
Verification queries for cycle two cannot see accepted replicas from cycle one.
Lease expiry is attempt replacement and requeues work without incrementing collectionCycle.
Agreement, verdict, and authorization evidence must all belong to the declared collection cycle.
A result-level requeue atomically stamps the new epoch and recomputed input hash for the new cycle.
Lease expiry and abandonment remain in-cycle and retain that cycle's stamped permit epoch.
Max in-flight expiry creates a new cycle stamped with the current permit epoch.
Split-evidence rerouting continues under the result cycle's stamped epoch rather than adopting a newer epoch.
An urgent-lane intent racing saturated capacity is denied atomically with a terminal typed receipt.
After the reserve window rolls, a fresh effect intent ID can consume newly available urgent capacity.
Emergency withdrawal of an epoch label is scoped to one class even when another class reuses the label.
A class withdrawal atomically requeues multiple collecting cycles with one recomputed input hash per job.
Revocation atomically changes worker state and requeues every open lease without discarding accepted evidence.
An identical class-version schema registration replays the durable record.
A reused class/version with different schema hashes conflicts without replacing the frozen record.
Pending adjudication reads preserve openedAt so oldest-backlog dwell can fail closed.
Reputation evidence IDs replay exact records, conflict on changed records, and never replace the first entry.
Core lists immutable candidates, selects one by policy, and gives Store a prepared lease plus the exact candidate and worker revisions.
The winning lease durably records priority, contribution window, slot occurrence, and accepted-worker diversity revisions.
A canary lease binds the source contract and expected-result hash without raw OAuth identity or expected-result body.
A core-prepared lease identity collision conflicts and leaves the existing durable identity unchanged.
A lease ID consumed before a stale candidate loses is not reused and creates no durable state.
Prepared enqueue compares queue and class-health revisions and fails after either changes.
Prepared compare-and-claim refuses a lease after queue or class-health revision changes.
Emergency queue and class state, result transitions, and authorization invalidation become visible together.
An automatic health refresh using an older revision cannot overwrite an operator halt.
Enqueue rejects a non-finite, non-positive, or above-declared lease TTL before a candidate can be listed.
Every extension is capped by the snapshotted count and remains strictly before the absolute in-flight deadline.
Registration uses the quantized maximum initial TTL and requires its extension envelope to stay strictly below maxInFlightLifetime.
A charge with a stale class policy version fails closed without consuming capacity.
A charge compares the explicit rollover identity and cannot debit a prior or future reserve window.
Registration requires both a split case and a JCS-distinct equivalent case that resolves and revalidates.
Every oracle predicate has out-of-domain plus support or omission failure cases, each explicitly bound to that predicate.
Worker registration creates the immutable worker and its core-prepared initial routing period atomically, with exact replay.
Core advances a complete routing period while Store preserves the open-lease set and owns the revision increment.
Every applied worker-state transition advances the routing revision so a claim prepared from the old eligibility state conflicts.
Class-health initialization is explicit: identical input replays and a changed initial value conflicts without replacement.
An ordinary prepared claim must carry the exact durable job payload and its existing payload reference.
A canary claim reuses its lease ID as the distinct payload reference and atomically persists that payload while preserving the displaced job payload.
A coarse no-work outcome atomically increments contribution usage and the routing revision without fabricating a lease.
